description: Trending new GitHub repositories: repos created in the last day, week or month ranked by stars (GitHub REST search API), filterable by language, topic and minimum stars. Returns full name, URL, description, language, topics, stars, forks, open issues, licence, created/pushed dates, owner type and a stars-per-day velocity. Cached 30 minutes. Uses the public API (not HTML scraping). Price: $0.01 USDC per successful call (x402, Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: GET https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/github-trending

language.description: GitHub language name, e.g. python, typescript, rust

since.description: daily, weekly (default) or monthly window for repo creation date

topic.description: GitHub topic, e.g. llm, mcp, agents

name: github_trending
title: Github Trending
